title: Sarawak Haze Eases Further as All Stations Drop Out of 'Very Unhealthy' Band
detail: Air quality across Sarawak continued improving on Sept. 13, with every monitoring station falling out of the 'very unhealthy' category by evening for the first time in over a week. By 6pm, Lubok Antu led at 198 (unhealthy), followed by Serian (173), Betong (165), Sri Aman (163), Kuching (155), Samarahan (153), Kanowit (143), Tebedu (135) and Lundu (112); Bario recorded the day's best reading at 38 (good). The Star's separate 4pm snapshot similarly found only five areas nationwide — four in Sarawak (Serian 174, Sri Aman 164, Samarahan 154, Kuching 154) plus Johan Setia, Selangor (131) — in the unhealthy range, with 56 areas moderate and 7 good. No station has recorded a hazardous reading since Sept. 8's brief spike at Serian.
